title: The Flight Logs (Court Exhibits)
summary: Pilot manifests for Epstein's aircraft entered as exhibits in Giuffre v. Maxwell, introduced at Maxwell's trial, and released via FOIA/DOJ disclosures (2,618+ known flights compiled). Names include Bill Clinton, Donald Trump, Prince Andrew, Kevin Spacey, Naomi Campbell, Chris Tucker, Alan Dershowitz, Jean-Luc Brunel, Larry Summers. They show who was on which flights — appearance establishes association, NOT wrongdoing, a distinction emphasized by DOJ, courts and fact-checkers.

sources.label: DOJ Epstein disclosures portal (flight logs released in tranches)

tldr: The DOJ's Epstein Library disclosures portal is real and age-gated, with 12 data sets plus court records — but the flight-log files themselves sit behind the age-verification gate, so the record's specifics weren't reviewable from the landing page.
ai_summary:
AI review of the DOJ Epstein disclosures portal landing page (justice.gov/epstein/doj-disclosures), read in full:
- Establishes the official 'Epstein Library': DOJ Disclosures Data Sets 1–12 plus a Court Records data set consolidating previously released court files.
- Access requires age verification (18+); the page carries a privacy notice citing the volume of material and the Epstein Files Transparency Act (H.R. 4405), with redactions of victim names and identifying information applied.
- Flag: the landing page does not list individual flights, the '2,618+' flight count, or passenger names — those live in files behind the age gate and were not in the text reviewed. The record summary's named individuals and the association-is-not-wrongdoing distinction were therefore not verifiable from this page. Partial verification only.
